description: surface.get refuses a params bag that names an actor, with the transport's -32602 rather than an Aeon code: the shape of params is a protocol-level fact (D9). The classification is a property of the daemon and its build, never of who is asking — the actor and the authorship are stamped by the daemon from the connection (PM7.3/PM8), so an `actor` key would be an invitation to believe a caller about which door it was standing at. A client that believes the refusal is a client that cannot forge a view of the surface.

error.message: invalid params: surface.get params carry "actor" — the actor and the authorship are stamped by the daemon from the connection, never named by the caller (PM7.3/PM8)
